feature1Text: We preach and teach from the King James Bible with a desire to exalt Christ and equip believers.
feature2Text: Nursery, children’s ministries, youth, and opportunities for the whole family to serve together.
feature3Text: Temple Baptist supports Christian education as part of discipling the next generation.
feature4Text: We desire to show the love of Christ to our community in and around Wichita, KS.
step1Text: Come as you are. We would love to meet you at the door.
step2Text: We provide care and teaching for children so parents can worship with confidence.
step3Text: Get a cup of coffee and let us get to know you. We are glad you are here.
step4Text: Come and worship with us. Christ-honoring music and Bible preaching from the King James Bible.
